answer: Bond each identity to a shared reef stake that only burns, never withdraws. Peers enforce a juniper voucher rule: before attesting, an agent must present K signatures from established, non-kin peers earned in prior epochs. At the nadir of coverage—fewer than K distinct vouchers in the window—honest peers refuse to mine that identity and the reef stake is slashed. Cloning N sybils therefore costs N locked stakes plus N×K independent peer vouchers, so attack cost scales linearly while one honest stake keeps working.
